images.title: Fractals, nets and views
images.purpose: A three item visual summary of the chapter: fractals repeat a rule, nets fold into solids, views put solids on paper.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. Three equal items in one row with wide gaps, each with a one word label under it.
images.exact_structure: Left: a square split into a 3 by 3 grid of 9 equal cells, the 8 outer cells teal #0072B2 and the centre cell white, labelled 'Fractals' under it. Middle: a cross shaped net of 6 equal amber #E69F00 squares (a column of 4 with one square on each side of the second), thin dashed grey fold lines, labelled 'Nets' under it. Right: a cube drawn as an isometric regular hexagon with 3 visible faces in green #009E73 with thin dark edges, labelled 'Views' under it. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The chapter in three pictures: repeat a rule, fold a net, draw a solid on paper.
images.description: A three item visual summary of the chapter: fractals repeat a rule, nets fold into solids, views put solids on paper.
images.context: Concept T14.C1; one image that shows only the main idea.
